title: Cobble & mons
description: A boosted Cobblemon experience featuring Mega Evolutions, new Legendaries, fresh biomes, unique structures, and a revamped villager trading system for smoother progression and deeper exploration.
body:
This modpack transforms Cobblemon into a fully‑fledged adventure experience. It introduces Mega Evolutions, new Legendary Pokémon, and a wide range of enhanced gameplay systems. Explore fresh biomes, discover unique structures, and encounter powerful Pokémon in locations you’ve never seen before.
A redesigned villager trading system adds new progression paths, rewards, and economy options, making every village feel alive and meaningful.
Perfect for players who want a richer, more dynamic Cobblemon world.
